difficulty_reason: For a complete Noetherian local ring (A, m, kappa) and a proper morphism X -> Spec(A) of algebraic spaces with dim X_kappa <= 1, the lemma concludes X is a scheme, projective over A. The retained proof is written in two named moves: the formal-algebraization theorem of the same chapter (lemma formal-algebraic-space-proper-reldim-1) produces a projective Y -> Spec(A) with Y x A/m^n isomorphic to X x A/m^n compatibly for all n (this is where the curve condition enters); the effectiveness/algebraization lemma of the chapter (lemma algebraize-morphism, a proper-morphism Grothendieck-existence avatar) upgrades the compatible isomorphism of formal completions to X congruent Y, hence X is projective. Retained author proof at lines 10403-10412.
